items.summary: Team lcolladotor Journal Club Presentation: "Conditional polygenic enrichment distinguishes causal from tagging disease-critical cell populations in single-cell RNA-seq"doi: https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.20.26360914Presented By: Manisha BarseDate: November 25, 2026scDRS-FM extends scDRS by integrating GWAS summary statistics with scRNA-seq data to identify disease associated cell populations. It uses conditional analysis to account for correlations between cell populations, distinguishing independently associated populations from those that merely tag the disease signal. This enables finer resolution of disease-relevant cell types and subpopulations.#GWAS #scRNAseq #MAGMA #scDRS #scDRS-FM
